notes: arsenal/media/sheet.py filmstrip(): n frames of [t0, t1) in one row (frame i = the middle of its slot) over the waveform of the same seconds (one audio track mixed to mono, dB scale, peak over RMS, streamed in 1 MiB chunks), with file-time ticks (and game time from a clockmap) and arsenal.stt words. Default geometry is the tested recipe: 8 tiles of 240x136 over 1920x120 = 1920x256. 10 s of the 33-min 1080p60 recording: 1.5-2.1 s. A span outside the file or an audio track the file does not have fails closed; a file with no audio gets the strip without a waveform. py -m arsenal.media filmstrip <v> 12:00 12:10.
